title: A Combined 3D Tissue Engineered In Vitro/In Silico Lung Tumor Model for Predicting Drug Effectiveness in Specific Mutational Backgrounds
protocol: Culture the HCC827 cell line in RPMI-1640 supplemented with 20% FCS.
Change medium every 2 - 3 days for HCC827 cells.
Split HCC827 cells twice a week until passage 20 is reached.
Culture the A549 cell line in RPMI-1640 supplemented with 10% FCS.
Perform culture conditions as stated above for A549 cells.
Split A549 cells twice a week until passage 20 is reached.
Test HCC827 and A549 cells regularly (every 4 - 6 weeks) for contaminations such as mycoplasma.
Place one sterile glass coverslip in each well of a 24-well plate using a tweezer.
Seed 50,000 tumor cells from both cell lines in a volume of 500 μl in the wells with glass coverslips.
Culture HCC827 and A549 cells until they reach a confluency of 70% under standard culture conditions (37°C; 5% CO2).
Aspirate old medium from the wells using a Pasteur pipette every 2 - 3 days during cell culturing.
Add 500 μl fresh medium to each well containing cells every 2 - 3 days.
Seed 100,000 cells of either HCC827 or A549 in a total volume of 500 µl onto the side of the former lumen of the gut fixed in cell crowns.
Allow tumor cells to adhere for 2 hr at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Add 1 ml medium inside the cell crown and 1 ml outside.
Culture the tumor model under static conditions at 37 °C, 5% CO2 in the incubator for 14 days.
Change culture medium every 2 - 3 days.
Aspirate the medium using a Pasteur pipette.
Pipette 1 ml fresh RPMI with the appropriate amount of FCS (A549: 10%, HCC827: 20%) inside the cell crown and 1.5 ml of the same medium outside.
Set up the tumor test system with the decellularized matrix inside the cell crowns and cell seeding as described under subsection 2.1.1 to 2.1.3.
Culture the tumor model under static conditions at 37 °C, 5% CO2 in the incubator for 3 days.
Assemble the autoclaved bioreactor and insert the seeded SISmuc as published previously.
Pipette 45 ml RPMI with the appropriate amount of FCS (A549: 10%, HCC827: 20%) into the flask.
Connect the needle-free sampling device to the tubing system between the bioreactor and the medium flask.
Place the bioreactor in the incubator, connect it to the pump.
Culture the tumor model for additional 14 days with a constant medium flow (3 ml/min) at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Change the entire culture medium after 7 days.
Move the bioreactor from the incubator to a laminar flow hood.
Aspirate the medium in the media flask using a Pasteur pipette.
Lift up the bioreactor while aspirating to remove medium from the tubing system.
Pipette 45 ml of fresh medium into the flask.
Place the bioreactor back into the incubator and connect it to the pump.
Culture the tumor model as described in section 2.1.
At day 11 of culture, prepare RPMI/FCS with 1 µM gefitinib (2.5 ml for each cell crown).
Aspirate the old medium from the wells using a Pasteur pipette.
Add 1 ml of prepared RPMI/FCS/gefitinib inside the cell crown and 1.5 ml outside.
Culture the tumor model as described in section 2.1.
At day 3 of culture, prepare RPMI/FCS with 2 ng/ml TGF-beta-1 with carrier (2.5 ml for each cell crown).
Aspirate the old medium from the wells using a Pasteur pipette.
Add 1 ml of prepared RPMI/FCS/TGF-beta-1 inside the cell crown and 1.5 ml outside.
Change medium supplemented with TGF-beta-1 every 2 - 3 days until day 14 as described under subsection 4.2.
Take samples from the supernatants during treatment with gefitinib at days 11-14 of culture and prior to treatment (T0).
Under static culture conditions, take 100 µl sample from the inside of the cell crown.
Under dynamic culture conditions, screw the syringe on the sampling device and take 1 ml medium out of the bioreactor system.
Store all collected supernatants at -80 °C until ELISA is performed.
Perform M30-ELISA for apoptosis quantification according to manufacturer's instructions.
Allow all reagents to reach room temperature before performing the assay.
Vortex all reagents.
Dissolve the wash tablet in 500 ml fresh deionized water.
Dilute HRP Conjugate with 9.2 ml of Conjugate Dilution Buffer and mix.
Pipette 25 µl of standard or sample per well.
Add 75 µl of the diluted HRP Conjugate solution per well.
Cover the plate and incubate it on a shaker for 4 hr at room temperature.
Wash the plate manually, 5 times with 250 μl of prepared wash solution.
Add 200 µl of 3,3',5,5'-Tetramethylbenzidine (TMB) substrate to each well.
Incubate in darkness at room temperature for 20 min.
Add 50 µl of stop solution to each well.
Shake the microplate for 10 sec.
Leave the microplate for 5 min before reading the absorbance.
Determine the absorbance at 450 nm in a microplate reader.
Calculate the standard curve and the concentrations in the samples using a suitable program for handling ELISA type data such as Origin.
Fix the seeded SISmuc using 2.5 ml of 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) per cell crown for 2 hr.
Embed the fixed SISmuc into paraffin.
Prepare 3 µm tissue sections for staining as published previously.
Wash cells cultured on glass coverslips in a 24-well plate once with PBS when they reach 70% confluence.
Fix cells with 500 µl of 4% PFA per well for 10 min.
Remove PFA and store the glass coverslips in the well-plate covered with PBS at 4 °C until staining is performed.
Stain the rehydrated sections with Hematoxylin/Eosin according to standard protocols.
Perform an antigen retrieval by placing the deparaffinized and rehydrated slides into a steam cooker with preheated citrate buffer (pH 6.0) for 20 min.
Transfer slides to washing buffer (0.5 M PBS buffer + 0.5% Tween).
Circle sections with PAP pen.
Block tissue sections with 5% serum from the host species of secondary antibodies for 20 min at room temperature.
Remove blocking serum by gently tapping slides on a paper tissue.
Apply primary antibody according to manufacturer's instructions (rabbit anti Ki67 1:100, rabbit anti vimentin 1:100, mouse anti pan-cytokeratin 1:100).
Incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Wash off unbound antibody with washing buffer three times for 5 min each.
Apply secondary antibodies in dilution 1:400 to the sections.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash off unbound antibody with washing buffer three times for 5 min each.
Mount slides with aqueous medium containing DAPI.
Let mounted slides dry overnight.
Remove PBS from seeded glass cover slips.
Cover glass cover slips with 0.2% Triton-X100 in PBS for 5 min for permeabilization.
Wash the glass cover slips with washing buffer (0.5 M PBS buffer + 0.5 % Tween) for 5 min.
Perform steps of blocking, applying primary antibodies, incubation, and detection as described previously.
Execute all steps in well-plate on a rocking platform.
Remove reagents by inverting the plate.
Spot a drop of aqueous medium containing DAPI onto an uncoated glass slide.
Transfer the cover slip to the drop with cells facing the mounting medium using forceps.
Let the cover slip dry before imaging.
Perform immunofluorescent staining against Ki67 according to section 5.3.4 or 5.3.
Take fluorescent images of tissue sections or 2D cultured cells with an inverted microscope.
Use different filters for DAPI and Ki67 stainings.
Quantify using 10 images of 3D sections or 5 images of 2D cultures (magnification 20X) from non-overlapping parts of the specimen.
Count the number of nuclei in each image manually using Fiji software's cell counter plugin.
Click "Plugins" → "Analyze" → "Cell Counter".
Press "Initialize" and select a counter type.
Click on each Ki67 positive nucleus to count them manually.
Create a macro for automatic cell counting of total nuclei using Fiji software.
Start macro recorder in Fiji.
Open a DAPI image and convert it to 8-bit format.
Click "Enhance contrast", set 'saturated' as "1" and normalize.
Set "unsharp mask" to sharpen the image with a radius of "1" and a mask of "0.60".
Click "auto threshold", choose method "RenyiEntropy" with 'white objects on black background' to binarise the image.
Click "Plugins" → "BioVoxxel" → "watershed irregular features" with an erosion radius of "5" to separate the cells.
Click "Analyze" → "Analyze Particles" and set the size to "0.02-Infinity".
Determine the number of nuclei and number of nuclei positive for Ki67 in 3D manually as described.
Calculate the mean proliferation index (PI) according to the provided formula.
Use different known databases to generate the tumor network based on important experimental read-out parameters and mutational background of the HCC827 cell line.
Open the network analysis software to visualize the network.
Open SQUAD software.
Click "Load Network".
Upload 'JoVE_tumor models.xml' file.
Click "Run analysis".
Click "Advanced".
Click "Perturbator".
Click "Edit Protocol".
Click "perturbation".
Use standard "initialstate=SS-4".
Click "Add".
Select parameter "state".
Select target "FLIP".
Select time "0".
Select value "0.4".
Click "OK".
Repeat.
Click "Add".
Select parameter "state".
Select target "c-MET".
Select time "0".
Select value "0.4".
Click "OK".
Repeat.
Click "Add".
Select parameter "state".
Select target "gefitinib".
Select time "0".
Select value "1".
Click "OK".
Set state value to active node (EGF-EGFR) to "0.8".
For all other nodes, set state value to "0".
Click "OK" to save the protocol.
Display specific curves by going to panel "Options".
Select "(EGF-EGFR)", "*(EGF-EGFR)", "*MEK", "caspases", "(c-MET)", "PI3K", "gefitinib", "apoptosis", "proliferation", "MEK-Inh" and "PI3K-Inh".
Click "Initialize" → "Run" to start a complete simulation of the system's response.
Simulate combined PI3K and MEK inhibitor treatment by clicking "Edit Protocol".
Use same node parameter as described under 6.2.2.1 - 6.2.2.3.
Click "perturbation" → Click "Add" to add 'new Constant Pulse'.
Select parameter "state" → Select target "PI3K-Inh" → Select time "0" → Select value "1".
Click "OK".
Click "Add" to add 'new Constant Pulse'.
Select parameter "state" → Select target "MEK-Inh" → Select time "0" → Select value "1".
Click "OK".
Click "OK" to save the protocol.
Go to panel "Options": Use same nodes for graphical representation as described under 6.2.2.4.
Click "Initialize" → "Run" to start a complete simulation of the system's response.
Click "Reset" to finish the simulation.
